help.unitConversions: Explicit item-specific conversion; factor is exact decimal text. Compatible standard mass, volume and count units use the domain's documented exact conversions; item-specific cross-dimension conversions require an explicit factor.
help.lots: Retained receipts and invoice amount. Declare whether additional landed costs are complete. Use either an exact invoice amount or the explicit unitPrice/priceQuantity/priceUnit basis. Keep the selected basis visible.
help.charges: Separate landed charges. Choose an explicit amount allocation or owner-selected weights.
help.chargeAllocations: Reference each charge and receipt lot. Complete amounts or positive allocation weights under the selected method.
help.standardSelections: Choose the exact retained lot whose unit cost should price each item in the standard BOM.
help.bomRevisions: Recipe revision and effective dates. Output quantity and unit are the recipe basis. Select additional standard recipe costs and their completeness explicitly.
help.bomLines: Ingredient/item or lower-level BOM revision requirements. componentType is item or bom; a nested BOM references its exact revision ID. required_input uses the entered quantity directly; net_before_loss uses the explicitly supplied yieldPercent.
help.batches: Actual good output and source-selected recipe. Scrap context is recorded separately; completeness controls describe actual known coverage.
help.consumption: Actual lot or upstream batch quantities consumed by each batch.
help.batchCosts: Actual selected labor, co-packer, packaging or other extra cost. Avoid recording costs already included in consumed inputs twice.
help.sales: Recorded revenue is explicitly gross or net_realized. Keep quantity, period, currency, batch and the selected deductions together.
help.fees: Choose deduct or already_in_revenue. The latter is disclosed without subtraction from net-realized revenue. Rate rows select recorded_revenue as the rate base.
